name: AWP + TRADES
tagline: Adversarial Weight Perturbation on top of TRADES: maximize TRADES loss in weight space, train under perturbed weights, restore.
pseudocode:
1. Generate $x_{\text{adv}}$ via TRADES PGD: maximize $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\text{adv}}\,\|\,p_{\text{clean}})$
2. Copy model -> proxy; proxy SGD ascends $\mathcal{L}_{\text{TRADES}}$ on $(x,x_{\text{adv}})$
3. For each weight param $w$ with dim>1: $\Delta = \frac{\lVert w\rVert}{\lVert w_{\text{proxy}}-w\rVert}\,(w_{\text{proxy}}-w)$
4. Apply $w \mathrel{+}= \gamma\,\Delta$ to model (gamma=0.005)
5. Compute TRADES loss on perturbed model, optimizer.step()
6. Restore: $w \mathrel{-}= \gamma\,\Delta$
diff_from_baseline: Wu, Xia & Wang 2020 (NeurIPS) AWP + Zhang et al. 2019 (ICML) TRADES. Flatness-aware AT: smooths the weight-space loss landscape by adversarially perturbing weights, then training on the perturbed network. Top robustness on RobustBench.

name: MART
tagline: Misclassification-Aware Regularized Training: boosted CE on adv + KL weighted by misclass probability.
diff_from_baseline: Wang, Zou, Yi, Bailey, Ma & Gu 2020 (ICLR). Down-weights confidently-correct examples and emphasizes hard / misclassified ones in both the CE-on-adv and KL terms; consistently improves robustness over PGD-AT and TRADES.

name: PGD-AT (Madry)
tagline: Min-max adversarial training: K-step PGD inside the loss, then plain CE on adversarial examples.
diff_from_baseline: Madry, Makelov, Schmidt, Tsipras & Vladu 2018 (ICLR). The canonical adversarial training algorithm: train on PGD-generated adversarial examples; default robust-training baseline.

name: TRADES
tagline: Decompose loss into clean CE + beta * KL(clean || adv); inner PGD maximizes the KL term.
diff_from_baseline: Zhang, Yu, Jiao, Xing, El Ghaoui & Jordan 2019 (ICML). Theoretically-motivated decomposition into clean accuracy + boundary regularization via KL between clean and adversarial predictions. Standard reference baseline alongside PGD-AT.

name: Standard (no AT)
tagline: Plain cross-entropy training without any adversarial perturbation; clean-accuracy upper bound, robustness floor.
diff_from_baseline: Standard ERM baseline. No adversarial defense: trains on natural inputs only. Gives the clean-accuracy upper bound and robustness floor (~0% under PGD); included as a reference point and lower bound for adversarial robustness.
